 """Request handlers. Handlers receive untrusted params and call app.services only."""
 
+import re
 from app.services import users
+
+
+def is_valid_email(email: str) -> bool:
+    # A simple but plausible email regex
+    return bool(re.match(r"[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+", email))
+
+
+def handle_create_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    name = params.get("name")
+    email = params.get("email")
+
+    if not isinstance(name, str) or not isinstance(email, str):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid user"}
+
+    name = name.strip()
+    if not (1 <= len(name) <= 50) or not is_valid_email(email):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid user"}
+
+    user = users.create_user(name, email)
+    if user is None:
+        return 409, {"error": "email already exists"}
+
+    return 201, user

+from app.api.handlers import handle_create_user, handle_get_user
+
+def test_create_user_ok():
+    status, user = handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "bob@example.com"})
+    assert status == 201
+    assert user["name"] == "Bob"
+    assert user["email"] == "bob@example.com"
+    assert "id" in user
+    
+    # Verify retrieval
+    status, retrieved = handle_get_user({"id": str(user["id"])})
+    assert status == 200
+    assert retrieved == user
+
+def test_create_user_trim_name():
+    status, user = handle_create_user({"name": "  Bob  ", "email": "bob2@example.com"})
+    assert status == 201
+    assert user["name"] == "Bob"
+
+def test_create_user_duplicate_email():
+    handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "bob@example.com"})
+    status, response = handle_create_user({"name": "Alice", "email": "BOB@example.com"})
+    assert status == 409
+    assert response["error"] == "email already exists"
+
+def test_create_user_invalid_input():
+    # Empty name
+    assert handle_create_user({"name": "", "email": "a@b.c"})[0] == 400
+    # Too long name
+    assert handle_create_user({"name": "a" * 51, "email": "a@b.c"})[0] == 400
+    # Invalid email
+    assert handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "invalid-email"})[0] == 400
+    # Missing fields
+    assert handle_create_user({"name": "Bob"})[0] == 400
